30 Days of Blender

Challenging myself to learn Blender this summer!

Why

This summer, I am spending thirty days in Blender! I want to make games and interesting 3.js animations at some point, so I want to be able to create my own assets. It’s a useful skill and a fun challenge. Between work and school, I will spend an hour a day.

Goals

  • Finish one render per day
  • Become good enough where I can make simple assets for games & animations
